ambient_events: The gate chain swings against the post with a slow, patient clang.
A security floodlight buzzes, dies, and buzzes again, powered by nothing you can find.
description: Chain-link and razor wire sag around a gatehouse with every window punched out. A faded sign still bolts to the fence: COLDWATER RECLAMATION — AUTHORISED PERSONNEL ONLY. Past it, the silhouettes of cracking towers rake at the sky.

flags.intro_lore: COLDWATER RECLAMATION owned everything past this fence — the furnaces, the fill, the men who fed both. The company's long gone; the appetite it built into this place isn't. Salvage crews and worse work the Slagworks now, and out here 'authorised personnel' just means whoever showed up armed. Mind the ground, mind the rats, mind the people who aren't rats.

name: Slagworks Gate
